d:
This story follows the events of The Avengers: The End of Time. We witness how Diana has been infected by the Darkhold and how she is dealing with it. Diana is also looking for Wonder Girl, who has been missing since the Avengers: troubles begin. What happened to her since she was captured by Ares, the god of war? Something dark is coming to the Justice League, and nobody is prepared for it!

If you’d like to delve deeper into the story, it’s already available on my Patreon, with the final chapter around part 26. You can also check out my other page for more content featuring transformation and corruption.
